load_lora_adapter: load pretrained LoRA attention processor layers into a UNet2DConditionModel from a model id or local path
save_lora_adapter: save LoRA attention processor layers from a UNet2DConditionModel to a directory as safetensors or pickle weights
load_ip_adapter_weights: load IP-Adapter weights into a UNet2DConditionModel including image projection layers and cross-attention processors
process_custom_diffusion: process custom diffusion state dict and return CustomDiffusionAttnProcessor instances for each attention layer
convert_ip_adapter_image_proj: convert IP-Adapter image projection state dict to diffusers ImageProjection classes like IPAdapterPlusImageProjection
